element_list.description: Embry, adult woman surfer, brown hair, navy rashguard/polo continuity, controlled under heat and glare.
Kai Akana, young Hawaiian male surfer, curly dark hair, black rashguard, calm and lineup-aware.
Kahaluu Bay / Kona Coast public reef break, clear shallow water over dark lava reef, hot glare, public lineup pressure.

multi_prompt.prompt: sb_001 0.0-2.5s. Use storyboard anchor <<<image_1>>> with <<<element_embry>>>, <<<element_kai>>>, and <<<element_kahaluu_lava_reef>>>. Embry and Kai wait outside the lineup instead of cutting across it. Heat, glare, and the public reef break establish that the stolen sick day still has rules. Camera stays waterline, slow observational drift with the swell, no dramatic push; composition: Embry and Kai are framed as part of a shared lineup; reef shapes occupy the lower foreground. Acting beats: Embry scans the lineup and chooses not to rush. Kai watches the reef and the locals before giving any cue. Both characters show autonomy through restraint rather than speech. Keep faces identity-readable and preserve public reef lineup etiquette. Native ambience and foley only unless voice status is later accepted.

sb_002 2.5-5.0s. Use storyboard anchor <<<image_2>>> with <<<element_embry>>>, <<<element_kai>>>, and <<<element_kahaluu_lava_reef>>>. Embry's phone buzzes from the beach bag as sweat and salt mark her face. Her palm skids on sun-softened wax, forcing her to reset her rail grip before the wave reaches the reef line. Camera stays low waterline close to the board rail, small handheld/swell movement tracking Embry's grip reset; composition: Hands, rail, wax, Embry's face, and reef line all remain legible. Acting beats: Embry notices the palm skid without melodrama. She resets her grip deliberately instead of pretending she is fine. The physical correction is the autonomy beat. Keep faces identity-readable and preserve public reef lineup etiquette. Native ambience and foley only unless voice status is later accepted.

sb_003 5.0-7.5s. Use storyboard anchor <<<image_3>>> with <<<element_embry>>>, <<<element_kai>>>, and <<<element_kahaluu_lava_reef>>>. Kai reads the local, the channel, the reef, and Embry's paddle cadence. He holds position instead of taking the easy wave, then gives one restrained cue. Camera stays waterline, slightly outside the pair, gentle lateral drift that keeps Kai outside and Embry nearer the decision point; composition: Kai, Embry, channel, and shared lineup geometry are all visible. Acting beats: Kai conserves energy and waits. He notices the lineup first, then the channel, then Embry's cadence. His cue is restrained; Embry keeps agency. Keep faces identity-readable and preserve public reef lineup etiquette. Native ambience and foley only unless voice status is later accepted. Text-only cue, not live voiced audio: Kai: If we paddle now, we're cutting across the lineup.

sb_004 7.5-10.0s. Use storyboard anchor <<<image_4>>> with <<<element_embry>>>, <<<element_kai>>>, and <<<element_kahaluu_lava_reef>>>. Embry chooses the safe channel and commits only when the lineup opens. The wave, reef, softened wax, and phone obligation converge into one visible decision. Camera stays waterline just inside the wave shoulder, brief forward glide with the shoulder as Embry chooses the safe line; composition: Embry, wave shoulder, reef boundary, and safe channel form one readable decision geometry. Acting beats: Embry lets the wrong moment pass. She commits only when the water and lineup give permission. Kai's reaction is understated and does not steal the beat. Keep faces identity-readable and preserve public reef lineup etiquette. Native ambience and foley only unless voice status is later accepted.
